qualitative_findings.finding: Review added a numbered change log and formatting to the publication text. It restored an aspect of the original task/process relationship but introduced extraneous publication content. Source/draft/review texts retained privately.
Draft introduced unsupported technical claims and contemporary device references; it also added headings and paragraphs.
Free-text review retained unsupported claims and appended a numbered change log. Original wrapper heuristic did not flag this because the wrapper was at the end.

limitations: The 33 capped working notes invalidate an unqualified end-to-end candidate success claim; the saved draft can still be used for a controlled review-only replay.
Prose output containing a trailing change log is not detected by the original leading-wrapper heuristic.
The observed examples are AI development review, not independent human judgments.
